method: Hand-curated semantic field layouts for the next 3 c2s opcodes with usable pcap sample counts (after the opcode-payload-schemas pass's 6 heaviest). All 3 yielded fixed 8-byte bodies. Layout structure inferred from per-byte entropy + u32 cardinality patterns, with high-byte clustering disambiguating actor-handles from selectors.

opcodeLayouts.blurb: Set-target request. 8-byte body: target actor handle + target selector / kind.

proposedFieldLayout.value: offsets 0..3: 30 unique u32 values across 118 samples; high-byte (offset 3) shows lower entropy than low bytes - consistent with 1.x actor-handle high-byte clustering (0x029b... known sample-player + a few NPC/peer ranges)
offsets 4..7: 16 unique u32 values across 118 samples; cardinality matches an enum/kind field (target-type selector: actor / location / NPC sub-target etc.)

opcodeLayouts.blurb: Lock-target request. 8-byte body mirrors SetTarget shape: target actor handle + lock kind.

proposedFieldLayout.value: offsets 0..3: 27 unique u32 values across 66 samples; same high-byte clustering as 0x00CD
offsets 4..7: 10 unique u32 values across 66 samples - sister of 0x00CD's selector field

opcodeLayouts.blurb: Map channel keepalive ping (BCS-Y-0327 emission evidence). 8-byte body: timestamp + param (often 0xFFFFFFFF).

proposedFieldLayout.value: offsets 0..3: 11 unique u32 values; offset 3 (MSB) is invariant 0x50 - matches Unix timestamps in the Dec 2012 capture range 0x50C66937..0x50C7XXXX. Decomp evidence (decomp_opcodes.json 0x0007): emitter writes `local_898 = timestamp` via __time64.
offsets 4..7: 16 unique values; per decomp evidence the dual-site emitter writes `local_894 = param / 0xFFFFFFFF`. FUN_00586F40 uses a real param value; FUN_00586FB0 fallback path uses 0xFFFFFFFF.
